name: 24and0
caption:
24-0. WHO STOPPED US? 🎮🏀 We won our first 24 games of 2015-16. Nobody had ever started better.

• Best start in NBA history, breaking the 1993-94 Rockets' mark
• Better than the 1884 St. Louis Maroons' 20-0: best start in US pro sports
• Win 24: 124-119 in double OT at Boston, Draymond with a 5x5 line
• The next night: Milwaukee 108, us 95
• It ended a 28-game win streak, the 2nd longest in NBA history

Will anyone ever start 25-0? 👇

facts.claim: 2015-16 Warriors won their first 24 games (24-0), eclipsing the previous best start in NBA history set by the 1993-94 Houston Rockets; broke the 131-year-old record of 20-0 set by the 1884 St. Louis Maroons baseball team for best start in all major professional sports in America (US pro sports); December 11 (2015): beat Boston 124-119 (2OT, double overtime) to improve to 24-0, Draymond Green recorded a five-by-five (5x5); the start ended when they were beaten by the Milwaukee Bucks 108-95 on December 12, 2015, which also ended a 28-game winning streak, the second-longest (2nd) in NBA history; 25-0 has never happened
